headline: The real Android app reaches account creation without taking personal data
overview: A live walk of a freshly built Scribe Quest Android APK through sign-in and account creation, stopping before credentials or an account write.

steps.title: Android explains why sign-in exists
steps.action: Built lib/main.dart, installed the debug APK, cleared its package data, and launched it.
steps.description: The actual Android app offers Google and email sign-in, says conversation history is account-scoped, and states that microphone permission is requested only when capture starts.
steps.screenshotAlt: Scribe Quest native Android sign-in screen

steps.title: Account creation is inspected, not submitted
steps.action: Scrolled to Create an account and opened the native form.
steps.description: The Android surface presents name, email, password, and Google options with no credit card required. The walkthrough stops before entering or submitting data.
steps.screenshotAlt: Scribe Quest native Android create-account screen

keyFeatures: Native Android Google and email sign-in
note: Built from lib/main.dart after discovering that the older app-release.apk was a native smoke harness. The source checkout was dirty only in existing Makefile, Firebase cache, and an untracked utility; no source files were changed for this capture.
